metas.name: Luca
metas.description: A heartwarming Pixar story about friendship and adventure that matches the tone of Turning Red and Moana.

metas.name: Elemental
metas.description: Like Inside Out, this film uses creative metaphors to explore emotions and family dynamics in a colorful city.

metas.name: Up
metas.description: An iconic adventure film that combines humor and heart, perfect for fans of Finding Nemo and Toy Story.

metas.name: Monsters, Inc.
metas.description: A classic buddy comedy that kids who enjoyed Despicable Me and Zootopia will find hilarious.

metas.name: Frozen
metas.description: Since the kids enjoyed Frozen II, they will love seeing the original story of Elsa and Anna.

metas.name: Wreck-It Ralph
metas.description: A high-energy video game adventure that appeals to fans of The Super Mario Bros. Movie and Sonic the Hedgehog.

metas.name: Big Hero 6
metas.description: An action-packed but sweet superhero story that aligns with the excitement of Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon
metas.description: A thrilling adventure about the bond between a boy and a dragon, similar in scale to The Sea Beast.

metas.name: Madagascar
metas.description: A funny, animal-centric comedy that fans of Sing and Rio will appreciate for its humor and music.

metas.name: Megamind
metas.description: A clever twist on the superhero genre that provides the same level of laughs as Despicable Me and Shrek.

metas.name: Trolls
metas.description: A bright, music-filled journey that captures the joy found in movies like Sing and Encanto.

metas.name: The Lego Movie
metas.description: Fast-paced, creative, and very funny, matching the energetic style of Spider-Verse and Mario.

metas.name: Paddington
metas.description: A charming and gentle family comedy about a polite bear, perfect for fans of wholesome adventures.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: Even more delightful than the first, this sequel is widely considered one of the best family films ever made.

metas.name: Minions
metas.description: A spin-off focusing on the most popular characters from Despicable Me, ensuring lots of slapstick comedy.

metas.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
metas.description: A visually inventive and quirky comedy from the same creative minds behind Spider-Verse.

metas.name: Hotel Transylvania
metas.description: A fun, non-scary monster movie that focuses on family bonds and humor, similar to The Grinch.

metas.name: The Secret World of Arrietty
metas.description: A Studio Ghibli film about tiny people, serving as a beautiful companion to The Borrowers and Totoro.

metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
metas.description: A visually stunning and hilarious modern family road trip movie that feels like a mix of Spider-Verse and Migration.

metas.name: Abominable
metas.description: A magical journey across China to return a Yeti home, perfect for fans of Raya and the Last Dragon.

metas.name: A Bug's Life
metas.description: A classic Pixar underdog story that fans of Kung Fu Panda and Chicken Run will enjoy.

metas.name: Finding Dory
metas.description: The wonderful sequel to Finding Nemo, continuing the underwater adventure with a focus on family and memory.

metas.name: Wish
metas.description: A modern Disney musical that celebrates the studio's history, ideal for kids who loved Tangled and Moana.

metas.name: Leo
metas.description: A funny and surprisingly touching story about a class pet, sharing the school-life relatability of Turning Red.

metas.name: Orion and the Dark
metas.description: A creative DreamWorks film that helps kids process fears in a way similar to Inside Out.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda 3
metas.description: The kids have seen the first two, and this third installment provides a great conclusion to the main trilogy.

metas.name: Shrek the Third
metas.description: Following Shrek and Shrek 2, this continues the fairy-tale satire they already enjoy.

metas.name: Bolt
metas.description: An action-adventure about a dog who thinks he has superpowers, fitting right in with Sonic and Zootopia.

metas.name: The Peanuts Movie
metas.description: A sweet, gentle, and visually lovely film that captures the innocent charm of Alice in Wonderland and Totoro.

metas.name: The Garfield Movie
metas.description: A brand new take on the famous cat, offering the same modern animation style as Migration and Mario.

metas.name: Smallfoot
metas.description: A musical comedy that flips the Bigfoot legend, perfect for kids who love the songs in Sing and Encanto.

metas.name: Over the Moon
metas.description: A visually stunning musical adventure based on Chinese mythology, similar to Moana and Raya.

metas.name: The Croods
metas.description: A fun adventure about a prehistoric family, capturing the same chaotic energy as The Bad Guys.

metas.name: The Cat Returns
metas.description: A whimsical Studio Ghibli adventure involving a kingdom of cats, perfect for fans of Kiki's Delivery Service.

metas.name: Home
metas.description: A cute sci-fi buddy comedy about an alien and a girl, similar in tone to Lilo & Stitch or Sonic.

metas.name: Shaun the Sheep Movie
metas.description: From the creators of Chicken Run and Wallace & Gromit, this is a masterclass in silent slapstick comedy.

metas.name: Ruby Gillman, Teenage Kraken
metas.description: A coming-of-age story involving secret identities and sea creatures, great for fans of Turning Red.

metas.name: Onward
metas.description: A fantasy quest about two brothers that combines the magic of Raya with the heart of Toy Story.

metas.name: Cars
metas.description: A beloved Pixar classic about racing and friendship that matches the high-speed fun of Sonic the Hedgehog.
